# Weightloss Tracker

> Free web app to track weight loss: log your weight, see BMI and body fat trends, set goals, earn achievements and get email reminders. Sign in with an email code, Google or Microsoft.

## Pages

- [Weightloss Tracker](https://weightloss-tracker.com/): what the app does, questions and answers, sign up or sign in
- [Privacy and cookies](https://weightloss-tracker.com/privacy): what is stored, cookies, outside services and your rights
- [Terms of use](https://weightloss-tracker.com/terms): the rules for using the service; not medical advice; governed by the law of England and Wales
